run_identity_decision.rationale: Attempt 5 / frozen v5 was rejected at independent CPU prelaunch audit (SHA-256 05d40c7d6ab73594fb8e60fb15de94f676e76d62f97ecae43dfcaba7225c0500) for three P0 isolation-attestation defects with zero model/tokenizer/CUDA/GPU/JarvisLabs access. Scientific bindings matched v4 and remain accepted. This attempt-6 successor corrects only the isolation contract (stdlib-first gate, interpreter-bound pyvenv.cfg, ModuleNotFoundError-only / find_spec flash_attn absence) while retaining denylist 465183/465186/465155/465072, axolotl/CPython 3.11.10, and safe_run --isolated-project-venv. Spent attempt-4 go is not reused. The 590/725 reference score remains attempt-4 evidence only.

hypothesis: The candidate-v2 (35M, 602/756) versus Qwen2.5-0.5B (663/756) gap cannot currently be attributed to parameter count versus pretraining-token budget. A matched-adaptation sweep over pinned base checkpoints (pythia-70m-deduped ~3e11 tokens; SmolLM2-135M ~2e12; SmolLM2-360M ~4e12) on the identical frozen Mobile Actions SFT recipe, scored on a fresh grouped selection split, separates the axes.
decision: Which base-model scale, and which axis (tokens versus parameters), the project adopts for the next post-training phase: the smallest configuration clearing a +3.0-point exact-match margin over the in-run candidate-v2 reference on the fresh selection split with schema validity >= 0.95 and zero truncations, missing predictions, and generation failures; otherwise explicit per-axis falsification.

attempt_6_corrections.INFRA-6: stdlib-only bootstrap — enforce_venv_isolation / stdlib_isolation_preflight run before any torch, transformers, training.data, mobile_matched, or pytest-bearing import on the production entrypoint; prove torch absent from sys.modules at gate entry
attempt_6_corrections.INFRA-7: resolve the active venv from sys.prefix / sys.executable; require pyvenv.cfg in that prefix with include-system-site-packages=false; if VIRTUAL_ENV is set it must equal sys.prefix — never trust an unbound VIRTUAL_ENV alone
attempt_6_corrections.INFRA-8: flash_attn absence uses find_spec without import plus ModuleNotFoundError-only classification; any ImportError indicating partial/broken extension (attempt-4 undefined symbol on flash_attn_2_cuda) fails closed; discoverable packages rejected without executing them
attempt_6_corrections.INFRA-9: retain safe_run --isolated-project-venv, axolotl/CPython 3.11.10, denylist including 465183/465186/465155/465072, and every scientific binding; all authorization flags remain false pending fresh independent v6 audit
